title: Pushing onto a represented stack
statement: For any stack $xs$ and symbol $a$, writing the embedded symbol $a$ at position $-|xs|-1$ in the tape representation of $xs$ yields the tape representation of the stack with $a$ prepended to $xs$.
replaced:
Updating the work-tape representation of a stack $xs$ by writing an embedded symbol
$a$ into the cell at position $-\abs{xs} - 1$ yields exactly the representation of
the pushed stack with $a$ prepended to $xs$.
